finding.expected: Constrain full EVIDENCE acceptance to allowed structural roles with their correct owner/lineage binding; reject unsupported or ambiguous placements rather than accepting by a generic field-set heuristic. Cover privacy projection and local/remote read-only reconciliation using targeted positive and adversarial tests for protected and unprotected metadata. Preserve the original four-RUN TASK-336 fixture, historical protections, no writes from Unified State, and all unaffected already valid verification evidence.
finding.issue: The generic metadata path recognizes full EVIDENCE from the presence of field names and can accept it through unowned or unexpected nested locations. An otherwise internally valid EVIDENCE in an unsupported structural placement can pass the metadata projection without a fail-closed structural owner or location check; existing invalid-full-EVIDENCE and tampering regressions do not establish rejection of a valid but misplaced foreign-owner record.
finding.location: src/aios_renew/unified_state.py: _matches_public_document.metadata, structural role dispatch and generic full_evidence detection

original_constraints: Carry forward the reviewed-published TASK-337 r2 protections and the r4 intended fail-closed V2 private/public terminal metadata reader semantics. A reference-only verification observation is not a full EVIDENCE object; complete EVIDENCE must still validate raw/result/identity, provenance, digests, correction ancestry, owner and privacy allowlists.

The authored repair-history fixture must construct every embedded REPAIR authorization with exactly the current production REPAIR schema (no extra affected_verification key or other unsupported keys); every constraint must be a verbatim member of the fixture TASK.constraints.hard, and execution scope must remain within authorized TASK/failed-changed-files. No fabricated new Human intent is allowed.

For normal AUTHOR_REPAIR tests, the initial unsigned/unaudited carrier must reach and be rejected specifically at the real audited_handoff gate, then the valid audited correction must canonicalize when all independent guards pass. A premature invalid REPAIR authorization or fixture Git error must never count as PASS.

For the changed-correction and missing-raw negative tests, the intentionally altered metadata Git commit must exist in the test bare remote object store before an expected-old-SHA compare-and-swap updates the test ref. Real Git and canonical parsing must reject corruption at the intended boundary; no bypass of CAS, provenance checking or production validation.

Retain explicit positive and adversarial tests for normal protected and non-protected terminal reconciliation, nested V2 FAILURE references, incomplete full EVIDENCE, forged or changed correction metadata, identity/head/digest mismatches and malformed lineage. Do not suppress tests, alter fail-closed parser to permit bogus corrections, re-label failures as expected, or relax a regex merely to accept an earlier unintended error.

Windows fixture construction must bind raw working-tree .ai inputs to exact committed Git bytes even under core.autocrlf=true, while adversarial CRLF-only drift remains rejected by production ingress. No mutation of the historical TASK-336 canonical refs or real Runtime artifacts.

Candidate may consult failed RUN-337-008 commit 486ffc0916fb270f4b21482a30a36ea502dda4ea and earlier r3 commits as unreviewed implementation references only. It must be independently authored from exact canonical main; do not cherry-pick unreviewed candidate as authority or skip applicable acceptance checks.

Modify only the three authorized paths. Do not change publication.py, authoring_ingress.py, verification_contract.py, workflows, Runner configuration, GitHub refs or protection, Runner admission, review/publication semantics, or the frozen Kernel. No new router, lifecycle retry authority, or parallel Executor.

Before declaring implementation ready, check the complete historical-fixture contract after each simulated correction across all four RUNs; not just the four previously reported test failures. A clean expected pass for all targeted acceptance tests must be supported by truthful output, not assertions alone.

Produce a complete structural ResultPackage with truthful claims that explicitly cover AC1-AC6 and identify the exact committed candidate and changed files. Runtime owns independent minimum-sufficient-v2 verification, proof validity/reuse and terminal lineage; do not execute identical authored full targeted suites redundantly solely as ceremony or claim invalid prior evidence as reusable.
